maddeler.e:
نتملغم (form IIq)
# نَتَمَلْغَمُ (natamalḡamu) /na.ta.mal.ɣa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَلْغَمَ (tamalḡama)
# نَتَمَلْغَمَ (natamalḡama) /na.ta.mal.ɣa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَلْغَمَ (tamalḡama)
# نَتَمَلْغَمْ (natamalḡam) /na.ta.mal.ɣam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَلْغَمَ (tamalḡama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
